crypto-merchants.title: Six-shop refundable checkout trial
crypto-merchants.outcome: Ship an open-source checkout, with refunds, and run it for three months at six named Owen Sound shops. Publish the code and the shop list, and the shops keep taking cash and ordinary cards for the whole trial.
crypto-merchants.blocker: No one shop can justify building a checkout whose useful result is a public trial record

crypto-merchants.title: Independent checkout security review
crypto-merchants.outcome: Pay a reviewer who does not write the checkout to publish findings and unfixed items before the Owen Sound trial ends.
crypto-merchants.blocker: The shops and the programmer are poor judges of their own security claims

crypto-merchants.title: Fee and failure table
crypto-merchants.outcome: Publish the fee on a twenty-dollar Owen Sound trial sale, and a table of failed payments, before anyone calls the trial a success.
crypto-merchants.blocker: The numbers are useful to every later shop and owned by none of them

crypto-merchants.title: Owen Sound merchant directory
crypto-merchants.outcome: Maintain, for one year, a directory that shows which trial shops still take the checkout and which shops stopped, with the date of each change.
crypto-merchants.blocker: A directory nobody maintains becomes an advertisement

crypto-merchants.title: Quarterly checkout clinic and host kit
crypto-merchants.outcome: Run four Saturday clinics in Owen Sound and leave a host kit so a second person can run the next one.
crypto-merchants.blocker: The clinic stops when the first host is busy unless the hosting steps are written down

civic-assimilation.title: Twelve conversation sessions
civic-assimilation.outcome: Hold twelve English conversation sessions in Owen Sound with childcare in the room, and publish attendance without naming children.
civic-assimilation.blocker: Childcare and a room have to be paid before the first session, and no single family captures the benefit

civic-assimilation.title: Grey County civics pack
civic-assimilation.outcome: Write and release a plain-English pack for the library, the bus, a school meeting, and a township office in Grey County.
civic-assimilation.blocker: Each office explains itself differently, and no office is paid to write the combined pack

civic-assimilation.title: Harrison Park path season
civic-assimilation.outcome: Run one summer of path repair in Harrison Park, Owen Sound, with newcomers and long-time residents, and publish hours and costs.
civic-assimilation.blocker: The work needs a full season of tools and insurance before anyone can see the paths

civic-assimilation.title: Conversation-session handoff
civic-assimilation.outcome: Write the steps, contacts, and childcare arrangements so a second organizer can run the next Owen Sound session series.
civic-assimilation.blocker: The sessions are a public good only if they survive the first organizer

civic-assimilation.title: Independent tutor-listing check
civic-assimilation.outcome: For one season, have someone who does not run the sessions check Grey County language-tutor listings and publish which listings failed.
civic-assimilation.blocker: A directory checked by its own organizer does not answer a skeptic

christian-teaching.title: Midweek class notes
christian-teaching.outcome: Release the notes for one Grey County congregation's midweek class under terms another congregation can reuse.
christian-teaching.blocker: The second congregation can copy the notes, so neither congregation is paid by the other to write them

christian-teaching.title: Midweek class transcript
christian-teaching.outcome: Transcribe that class for people who cannot hear the recordings, and publish the transcript with the confession named.
christian-teaching.blocker: Transcription is useful to every later listener and costly to the first congregation

christian-teaching.title: One-season substitute rota
christian-teaching.outcome: Publish a Sunday rota and sermon notes so a substitute can preach at one named Grey County church for one season.
christian-teaching.blocker: Each small church has too few substitutes to keep the rota alone

christian-teaching.title: Second-church host kit
christian-teaching.outcome: Write a one-season kit so a second Grey County church can run the same rota without the first host.
christian-teaching.blocker: The rota dies with the first host unless the steps are written down

christian-teaching.title: Grey County class-host directory
christian-teaching.outcome: Publish one directory of Grey County people who will host a small class, with affiliation and an independent checker's note, and maintain it for one year.
christian-teaching.blocker: Churches, tutors, and home-school hosts each need the same checked list, and none of them owns it

home-learning.title: Printable grade-six science unit
home-learning.outcome: Release one grade-six science unit a Grey County family can print, with the teaching method named on the first page and no religious claims in the activities.
home-learning.blocker: Every family can copy the unit after the first author writes it

home-learning.title: Grey County field-trip pack
home-learning.outcome: Release the permission form, map, and safety notes for one Grey County field trip so another family, including a school family, can run it.
home-learning.blocker: The first family pays for the reconnaissance and every later family can copy the pack

home-learning.title: Store-item science kits
home-learning.outcome: Publish instructions for a home science kit of ordinary store items, including hazards and the adult supervision each activity needs.
home-learning.blocker: A safe kit has to be tried once before other families can reuse it

home-learning.title: Eight Owen Sound Saturdays
home-learning.outcome: Host eight Saturday meetups in Owen Sound for home-school families and publish the dates before the first meeting.
home-learning.blocker: The room and the dates have to be reserved before any family can rely on them

home-learning.title: Successor host notes
home-learning.outcome: Name a successor and write the notes so the Owen Sound meetups can run a second season without the first host.
home-learning.blocker: A meetup series that only the first host can run is not a maintained public good
